previous_statement: By the defining action of the tensor-product amplification of a linear map on an elementary tensor, (1_{M_n} tensor Co_Q)(E_{11} tensor Z)=E_{11} tensor Co_Q(Z). Applying the equality of maps from node 1.2 to E_{11} tensor Z therefore yields Co_{I_n tensor Q,I_n tensor Q}(E_{11} tensor Z)=E_{11} tensor Co_Q(Z), which is the assertion of node 1 for the universal positive choice e_nat=e_cmp.
new_statement: For every linear map T:A->A, the tensor-product amplification 1_{M_n} tensor T acts on elementary tensors by (1_{M_n} tensor T)(X tensor Z)=X tensor T(Z). Hence, for T=Co_Q and X=E_{11}, (1_{M_n} tensor Co_Q)(E_{11} tensor Z)=E_{11} tensor Co_Q(Z).
